# Vendored from the Nithron packages

- `nithron-pixel.json`: the Nithron Pixel face (font 1.000) as bitmaps. It comes from `@nithron/tokens` `fonts/nithron-pixel.json` (package 0.5.0; the same face as the `nithron-pixel.woff2` in `web/public/fonts`).
- `icons.json`: `@nithron/icons` 0.2.0 as bitmaps, the same set as `web/src/vendor/nithron-icons`.

Both are under the Nithron Community License v1.0. `assets/brand/build.mjs` reads them. Replace each file whole from the package; never edit it.
